meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析RNA-seq数据来发现基因间的调控连接
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target gene relationships from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover regulatory interactions from RNA-seq data

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用你的基因表达数据推断基因调控网络，找出哪些转录因子调控哪些靶基因。它提供 GRNBoost2 和 GENIE3 两种算法，可自动利用多核或分布式集群加速计算。
howto.when: 当你说要分析转录组数据（如 bulk RNA-seq、单细胞 RNA-seq）来推断基因调控网络、识别转录因子与靶基因关系时。

say.text: 用 GRNBoost2 从这份表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控网络。
say.note: 会运行推断并返回 TF—靶基因—重要性分数表。

say.text: 改用 GENIE3 再跑一遍同一个表达矩阵，对比两种算法的结果。
say.note: 会得到另一份调控网络结果用于对比。

say.text: 把结果按重要性大于 0.5 过滤，并保存成文件。
say.note: 会筛出高置信度的调控连接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data, identifying which transcription factors regulate which target genes. It offers GRNBoost2 and GENIE3 algorithms and supports parallel/distributed computation via Dask.
howto.when_en: When asked to analyze transcriptomics data (e.g., bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to infer gene regulatory networks or identify transcription factor-target relationships.

say_en.text: Use GRNBoost2 to infer a regulatory network from this expression data.
say_en.note: Runs inference and returns TF-target-importance links.

say_en.text: Run GENIE3 on the same matrix for comparison.
say_en.note: Produces an alternative network for comparison.

say_en.text: Filter the results to importance > 0.5 and save to a file.
